title: Jat Kusar
extract:
The Jat Kusar is a  Grineer Blade and Whip with rocket boosters attached, giving it innate  Heat damage. This weapon was originally based off a fan design which Digital Extremes incorporated into the game.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Heat damage.
Heavy Attacks cause an explosion dealing 218  Blast damage.
This explosion is treated as Slam Radial Damage and its damage can only be increased with  Seismic Wave.
Slam Radial Damage deals  Heat damage.
Two innate  polarities.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Defiled Snapdragon and  Tainted Hydra (Conclave only) stance.

Acquisition
The Jat Kusar's blueprint can be researched from the Chem Lab in the dojo.

This weapon can be sold for  5,000.

Combos

Notes
The Jat Kusar, unlike other Blade and Whips, does not ragdoll and pull enemies towards the player upon landing the fourth attack of the stanceless/Claws of the Drake combo or Heavy Attacks.
Instead, Heavy Attack direct hits only knock enemies down, while the explosions ragdoll and throw the enemy a small distance straight up into the air.
The Slam Radial Damage has a small chance to inflict the  Heat status effect, but is unaffected by status chance mods.

Trivia
The Jat Kusar is the winning entry of Digital Extremes' The Best Defense Melee Creation Contest. It was designed by Silverbones, who also created the  Silva & Aegis, another  Heat-based melee weapon.
In the Jat Kusar's concept art, Silverbones refers to the weapon as a "Plasma Kusarigama".

Bugs
The explosion caused by Heavy Attacks is not centered on the visual explosion. It is instead centered on the player, like a Slam Attack.
